name: Local and nonlocal quantum Hall transport of hBN/graphene Hall bars on YIG at 2.7 K and 9 K up to 12 T
plain_name: Measure quantized Hall conduction in graphene on a magnetic insulator
description: Measure Rxx, Rxy and nonlocal resistance of top-gated hBN/graphene Hall bars on Y3Fe5O12 with 7 Hz lock-in amplifiers (50 nA at 2.7 K, 100 nA at 9 K) versus magnetic field 0-12 T, gate voltage and field angle (manual sample rotation).
keywords: Measure quantized Hall conduction in graphene on a magnetic insulator

sources.citation: Y. Li, M. Amado, T. Hyart, G.P. Mazur, V. Risinggård, T. Wagner, L. McKenzie-Sell, G. Kimbell, J. Wunderlich, J. Linder, J.W.A. Robinson, 'Transition between canted antiferromagnetic and spin-polarized ferromagnetic quantum Hall states in graphene on a ferrimagnetic insulator', arXiv:1905.06866

requirements.rationale: Data were taken at 2.7 K and at 9 K.
The quantum Hall CAF-to-F transition is driven with fields up to 12 T.
Four-terminal and nonlocal resistance require wired contacts to the device.
Optional: the Hall bar has at least ten numbered contacts (plus a top gate).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
